items.localChanges: Retains Skia BGRA surface allocation, drawing and lifecycle behavior; replaces Avalonia render contracts with an internal generation-aware frame, backend-neutral primitive entrypoints, presenter delegate and top-down BGRA8888 readback. DisplayList ordering and frame ACK remain outside the vendor assembly.

Retains the Skia GRContext and default-framebuffer render target lifetime pattern; replaces Avalonia OpenGL and render-session contracts with internal delegates, generation checks, explicit raster-thread ownership, device-loss diagnostics and raster-thread BGRA8888 readback.
